# Karots POS

> A self-hosted point-of-sale system for retail shops. One static binary backed
> by PostgreSQL, runs on hardware you own — no monthly fee, no internet
> dependency. Built for selling on credit, tracking lots and expiry, managing
> suppliers and reconciling cash, with compile-time plugins per shop and
> white-label branding.

Site: https://pos.karots.lk/
Built by: Sheik Adhnan (https://karots.lk) — available for freelance work.
Contact: adhnanmsa@gmail.com · +94 76 962 6396 · https://github.com/Adhnan23

## What it is
- Self-hosted, offline-first POS. The till, inventory, cash and reports run on a
  single machine or LAN; nothing stops working if a subscription lapses or the
  internet drops.
- One static binary + PostgreSQL. Installs on ordinary PCs (old ones included),
  Windows or Linux. Supports thermal ESC/POS printers, cash drawers and scanners.

## Core capabilities
- Till & checkout: grouped product menu, scan or forgiving search, split payments
  across cash/card/credit, instant change with change-kept rounding.
- Credit customers: running balances with credit limits and manager override,
  collections, customer statements.
- Inventory: batches/lots with FEFO costing, expiry warnings at the till,
  categories at any depth, valuation, stock intake with label printing.
- Suppliers, cash lockers and reconciliation, discounts, returns and warranty.
- Reports: sales, profit by category (net revenue, COGS, profit, margin), peak
  hours, losses & recovery.
- Barcode labels: choose the top/bottom line fields and quantity; prints CODE128.
- Plugins compiled in per shop (recharge, repairs, documents, clearance,
  alternatives, AI catalog and more). White-label skins and receipt styles.

## Pricing (LKR; USD approximate)
- Offline Software: one-time LKR 45,000 (~$150).
- Complete Setup: LKR 100,000 (~$335) — most complete.
- Online: LKR 20,000 (~$70) setup + LKR 2,000 (~$7) / month.
- First month of support free; training free; custom features extra.

## FAQ
Q: Does it need the internet?
A: No — it is offline-first and runs on your own PC or local network.

Q: What does it run on?
A: Ordinary PCs on Windows or Linux, with thermal ESC/POS printers, cash drawers
   and barcode scanners.

Q: Can it sell on credit?
A: Yes — credit customers with limits, split payments and supplier accounts are
   core features.

Q: Is it customizable?
A: Yes — features are compiled in per shop as plugins, and the look is
   white-labelled. Custom features are available on request.
